publicQuestion: How many integer solutions does the equation x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 = 30 have, subject to the constraints 1 ≤ x1 ≤ 10, 2 ≤ x2 ≤ 8, 3 ≤ x3 ≤ 12, 0 ≤ x4 ≤ 9, and 4 ≤ x5 ≤ 15? Give just the integer.

judgeNote.validityReason: A well-defined constrained integer composition problem. Verified by both brute-force enumeration and generating function (polynomial multiplication) methods, both yielding 4861.
